ORDER WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR JUSTICE S VISHWAJITH SHETTY  ORAL ORDER Accused in SPl.C.No.336/2024 pending before the Court of Additional District & Sessions Judge,
FTSC-I, Hassan, arising out of Crime No.105/2024 registered by Konanur Police Station, Hassan,
for the offences punishable under Sections 363 & 376 of IPC and Sections 4 & 8 of Protection of Children From Sexual Offences Act 2012, ( for short, 'POCSO Act'), is before this Court under section 439 of Cr.P.C, seeking regular bail.
2. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and learned HCGP for respondent No.1.

sentences.text: Respondent No.2 who is served in the matter has remained unrepresented before this Court.

3. F.I.R. in Crime No.105/2024 was registered by Konanur Police Station, Hassan, initially for the offence NC: 2024:KHC:45945 punishable under Section 363 of IPC, against unknown persons, on the basis of first information dated 20.05.2024 received from respondent No.2, who is the father of the victim girl.
During the course of investigation, the petitioner and the victim girl were traced and the petitioner was arrested on 06.07.2024 and subsequently remanded to judicial custody.
Investigation in the case is completed and charge sheet has been filed against the petitioner for the aforesaid offences.
4. The bail application filed by the petitioner in before the jurisdictional Sessions Court in Spl.C.No.336/2024 was rejected on 25.09.2024.
Therefore, he is before this Court.
5. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that material on record would go to show that the petitioner and the victim girl were in love.
The victim girl in her statement recorded under Section 161 of Cr.P.C has categorically stated that the petitioner did not have sexual intercourse with her.

Subsequently in her statement NC: 2024:KHC:45945 recorded under Section 164 of Cr.P.C.,
improvement is made.
The victim girl has voluntarily accompanied the petitioner and had stayed with him.
Investigation is completed and charge has been filed and the petitioner has no criminal antecedents.
Accordingly, he prays to allow the petition.

sentences.text:
Per contra, learned HCGP has opposed the bail petition and submit that the victim is a minor and therefore alleged offences get attracted against the petitioner and he prays to dismiss the petition.
7.

First information was submitted by the father of the victim girl on 20.05.2024 after the victim girl was found missing from their house on 16.05.2024, efforts made by the first informant and his relatives to trace her had failed and therefore, on 20.05.2024 first informant had approached the police.

During the course of the investigation the petitioner and the victim girl were traced and the petitioner who was arrested on 06.07.2024 was produced before the Jurisdictional Court and remanded to NC: 2024:KHC:45945 judicial custody.
Investigation in the case is completed and charge sheet has been filed against the petitioner.

8. During the course of investigation, the statement of the victim girl under Section 161 of Cr.P.C.
was recorded on 23.05.2024.
Victim has stated that she was in love with the petitioner who is her relative, for the last four years.
In the said statement, she has categorically stated that the petitioner had hugged and kissed her, but he did not have sexual intercourse with her.

The statement of the victim girl under Section 164 of Cr.P.C. was subsequently recorded 29.05.2024, even in her 164 Cr.P.C. statement she has stated that she was in love with the petitioner for the last four years.

She has further stated that since her parents intended to perform her marriage with another boy, she had left her house and traveled with the petitioner to Bengaluru on 16.05.2024 and thereafter they stayed in his friend's house.
She has stated had on 17.05.2024 they had consensual sex.
On 22.05.2024 she had returned from Bengaluru to Konanur NC: 2024:KHC:45945 in a bus.
Even in her statement recorded by the Doctor at the time of her medical examination, she has stated that she was in love with the petitioner for the last four years.
9. Investigation in case is completed and charge sheet has been filed.
Allegation now made as against the petitioner in the charge sheet is required to be proved in the full-pledged trial.
Petitioner has no criminal antecedents and he is in custody from 06.07.2024.
Considering the aforesaid aspects of the matter, I am of the view that the petitioner's prayer for grant of regular bail is required to answered affirmatively.

10. Accordingly, the following:
ORDER The Criminal Petition is allowed.
